title: Beneath the Heavenly Eye
next_chapter_hook: Just as everyone thought the truth had been revealed, the sky suddenly darkened. An eye beyond mortal comprehension slowly opened. How will Chen Ji, who has received a kill order, face this catastrophic disaster that surpasses even the will of Heavenly Dao?

text.content: The Grand Elder's gaze pressed down like physical weight, and the crowd automatically parted to create a path. Only Chen Ji stood in place, wearing his usual timid smile, but his fingers were secretly caressing the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out in his Mental Sea: 'It's here. The opportunity you've waited three years for.' Chen Ji took a deep breath, silently reciting—yes, he had waited too long for this moment.

dialogue.content: Grand Elder, please stay. There is something this junior does not understand, and I venture to ask.

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward slowly, his aura suddenly transforming. Just now a timid servant disciple, yet now he possessed an imposing presence like towering mountains and deep seas. The surrounding crowd gasped in shock as someone recognized the silver-edged robe he wore—a Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince's official attire! The entire main hall instantly fell into a pin-drop silence.

dialogue.content: Han Lie's pupils constricted sharply as he shouted furiously: 'When did you, this waste... Grand Tutor? How dare you impersonate a court official! What is your crime!'

text.content: Chen Ji didn't even raise his eyelids, saying calmly: 'If Chief Han has doubts about the court's reward, feel free to check the archives at the Taichang Temple. This official is here only to ask the Grand Elder of Xuanwu Sect one question.' He turned to the Grand Elder, his voice suddenly turning cold, 'May I ask, Grand Elder, at the third watch last night, what were you conversing with in the secret chamber in the Xuanwu Sect's Back Mountain?'

choice.prompt: The Grand Elder's expression slightly changed. How do you choose to press further?

choices.text: Directly display the Tianji Record's phenomenon
choices.description: Activate the sixth page of the Tianji Record, projecting the anomaly on the Grand Elder's body for everyone to see, crushing with absolute evidence.
choices.visible_reward: The truth is revealed to all, the Grand Elder has no defense
choices.risk_hint: Expose part of the Tianji Record's abilities, which may attract higher-level attention
choices.process_label: 你选择以最强硬的姿态，正面碾压！

text.content: Chen Ji formed a seal with one hand, and the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve suddenly emitted dazzling golden light. Amid the crowd's exclamations, a illusory image rose from the fragment—a pale vertical pupil, watching the Grand Elder from the Xuanwu Sect's Back Mountain secret chamber!
The Grand Elder's body stiffened, his face turning deathly pale. The black patterns faintly appearing around him resonated with that vertical pupil, revealing an unspeakable connection.

choices.text: Use words to peel away layer by layer
choices.description: Don't rush to reveal your trump card. First use a series of questions to shake the Grand Elder's psychological defenses, letting him expose himself in front of everyone.
choices.visible_reward: The Grand Elder exposes his own flaws, the truth is even more shocking than what you could say
choices.risk_hint: The Grand Elder may act desperately and attack on the spot
choices.process_label: 你选择以言语为刃，一步步将他逼入死角！

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, smiling faintly: 'Grand Elder, no need to be nervous. This junior is merely curious. I heard that Xuanwu Sect's elders throughout history all had lifespans no more than three hundred years, yet you have already lived for twelve hundred years. What is your secret to longevity?'

A flicker of panic appeared in the Grand Elder's eyes as he forced himself to remain composed: 'This old man broke through during seclusion, what is strange about extending one's lifespan...' Before he finished speaking, his sleeves unconsciously drew back, and the fleeting black patterns were caught by sharp-eyed observers.

dialogue.content: Han Lie stepped in front of the Grand Elder, eyes blazing: 'Nonsense! My master is virtuous and respected, how dare you slander him! Men, seize this madman!'

text.content: Chen Ji laughed lightly, that laughter was clear yet carried bone-piercing coldness: 'Chief Han, why so agitated? Could it be you also know something?' His gaze swept across the crowd, 'Ladies and gentlemen, do you remember the war between Xuanwu Sect and the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path a century ago? In that battle, Xuanwu Sect fought against three alone, with heavy casualties—yet just ten years after the war, it recovered, and the number of experts in the sect doubled.'

dialogue.content: This recovery speed doesn't look like a righteous sect at all. It seems more like... someone constantly feeding it blood.

text.content: This statement caused an uproar. Everyone whispered, their gazes shifting between the Grand Elder and Han Lie. The Grand Elder's face turned ashen, his hand inside his sleeve trembling slightly. He never expected that this servant disciple, whom the entire world deemed useless, would掌握着如此惊人的情报.

choice.prompt: The situation has already turned in your favor. How do you choose to deliver the final blow?

choices.text: Reveal the Tianji Record's ironclad evidence
choices.description: Don't give the Grand Elder any chance to catch his breath. Directly activate the Tianji Record, showing everyone that eye that surpasses Heavenly Dao.
choices.visible_reward: The truth is irrefutable, Xuanwu Sect is condemned by all
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye will surely be furious and may strike on the spot
choices.process_label: 是时候终结这场闹剧了！

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more. Golden light blazed in his palm. The sixth page of the Tianji Record burst open, and a soul-stirring image shot into the sky—that was a giant eye spanning the heavens, its pupil reflecting countless distorted human figures, the very puppets controlled by the Heavenly Eye through the ages!

dialogue.content: Ladies and gentlemen, please look! This is Xuanwu Sect's backing—the Heavenly Eye! It feeds on geniuses from all sects, using all living beings as its chess pieces!'

choices.text: Expose the case of missing Xuanwu Sect disciples
choices.description: Throw another bombshell—the truth about the mysterious disappearance of Xuanwu Sect disciples, completely pinning the Grand Elder down.
choices.visible_reward: The crowd spontaneously turns against him, the truth is even more shocking than expected
choices.risk_hint: May be counter-attacked by the Grand Elder
choices.process_label: 你以为这就完了？真正的猛料还在后头！

text.content: Chen Ji said coldly: 'Since the Grand Elder does not admit it, this junior will ask another question—over the past thirty years, seventy-three genius disciples of Xuanwu Sect went out for '历练' and never returned, yet their soul lamps still burn brightly in the sect. Where are these people?'

Someone in the crowd exclaimed: 'My cousin was one of them! He said he was going to Xuanwu Sect for an exchange and never came back!' More and more voices of doubt arose, and cold sweat dripped from the Grand Elder's forehead.

Just as everyone was in an uproar, the sky suddenly darkened. An oppressive might descended from beyond the nine heavens, and everyone instinctively looked up—that pale vertical pupil finally revealed itself from the depths of the clouds.

dialogue.content: 'Despicable ants, daring to peer at this one's true form.'

text.content: That voice did not enter their ears but rang directly in everyone's Mental Sea. Those with shallow cultivation当场七窍流血，瘫软在地。即使是韩烈这等级别的天才，也面色惨白，双腿打颤。唯有陈机负手而立，唇角甚至勾起一抹笑意——他等这一刻，已经等了整整三年。

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye manifests to question. How do you respond?

choices.text: Retreat to advance, reveal the truth
choices.description: Don't directly confront it. Instead, inform the world of the Heavenly Eye's true face, making it hesitate to act.
choices.visible_reward: The Heavenly Eye becomes the target of all, Chen Ji escapes in the chaos
choices.risk_hint: May be instantly erased by the Heavenly Eye
choices.process_label: 你以为显现真身就能吓住我？可笑！

dialogue.content: Chen Ji said loudly: 'Everyone! This is the truth! The Heavenly Eye is not some divine will at all, but an ancient凶物 that feeds on living beings! Xuanwu Sect is merely its pig farm!'

text.content: Before he finished speaking, the Heavenly Eye's pupil suddenly constricted. A destructive force chopped down from the clouds, aiming directly at Chen Ji! Yet it was blocked mid-air by a sword light—Ye Qing's figure appeared in front of Chen Ji, with surges of demonic mist.

choices.description: Activate all fragments of the Tianji Record, clash head-on with the Heavenly Eye, displaying true strength.
choices.visible_reward: Repulse the Heavenly Eye's strike before everyone, becoming famous across the world
choices.risk_hint: Zero Heavenly Fate points, may die on the spot
choices.process_label: 想杀我？先问问天机录答不答应！

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes blazed with brilliance. Six pages of the Tianji Record simultaneously unfurled from his sleeve, golden light and black radiance colliding violently in mid-air. Everyone felt the world spinning. That Heavenly Eye was actually forced back several zhang, and rare astonishment appeared in its pupil.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji said proudly: 'A thousand-year layout ends today!'

text.content: The Heavenly Eye's vertical pupil slightly narrowed, its icy voice reverberating through heaven and earth once more: 'Interesting... After a thousand years, another person who can see this one has finally appeared.' Its gaze fell upon Chen Ji, carrying scrutiny and greed, 'The fragments in your hand, this one must have.'

Chen Ji remained unmoved, even smiling: 'If the predecessor wants it, feel free to take it. However, everyone present today is a witness—the Heavenly Eye itself admits that it is the mastermind behind the chaos in the world for the past hundred years!' He turned to the crowd, cupping his hands, 'Fellow cultivators, after today, where you go and what you do, please consider carefully.'

dialogue.content: Han Lie's face was ashen, yet he had no words. He turned to look at the Grand Elder, only to find this respectable elder trembling all over—the black patterns on his sleeve had already spread to his neck—that was the sign before the Heavenly Eye discards a pawn.

text.content: The Heavenly Eye's voice sounded again, but no longer directed at Chen Ji—it was announcing to the entire world: 'From this day forward, a Heavenly Kill Order is issued. Whoever brings me Chen Ji's head may enter my seat and enjoy eternal life.' That voice was ice-cold and marrow-piercing, 'Let all under heaven punish him together.'

The moment the kill order fell, Chen Ji threw his head back and laughed heartily. That laughter was畅快淋漓, as if he wanted to vent all the depression accumulated over three years. He looked at that high-and-mighty Heavenly Eye, silently reciting: You think I am the prey, but you don't know I am the chess player. This game has just begun.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his Mental Sea, carrying rare gratification: 'Well done. The road ahead will be even harder. But you have taken the hardest step.' Chen Ji slightly nodded, looking around—the crowd showed shock, fear, and also a few gazes burning with fighting spirit. He knew that after today, the world would no longer be peaceful, and he, Chen Ji, would stand at the forefront, overlooking this heaven and earth about to overturn.
